issue_context.title: Crash when using `OS.move_to_trash()` on a path that does not exist
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v3.5.1.stable.official [6fed1ffa3]

### System information

w10 64

### Issue description

Little to say, the program closes when the red button is pressed (OS.move_to_trash())
OS.move_to_trash with a false path or with a nonexistent file crashes.
The problem happens on windows.
Ignore the attached project folder name "testAndroid".

![Captura](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19652075/194762909-ad74a8e2-0d87-49b8-b9dd-47801dfe4ec0.PNG)

![Captura2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19652075/194762913-fda51669-e528-458d-b380-ba1ee2c7763c.PNG)


### Steps to reproduce

Execute and press red button.
Red button executes OS.move_to_trash.

### Minimal reproduction project

[testAndroid.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9741806/testAndroid.zip)

*Bugsquad edit (keywords for easier searching): move_to_trash*
